_comment: Items and the MATHMART stock (bug report: item list and prices). use: battle, field, both, or key (never used up). effect values are fractions of max HP, Focus points, capture-chance bonus (percentage points), or a damage multiplier for the rest of the battle. price 0 = not sold.

Basic Mathball.description: Captures a weakened wild monster after a binding challenge.

Attack Boost.description: Your monsters deal 25% more damage for the rest of the battle.

Defence Boost.description: Your monsters take 25% less damage for the rest of the battle.

Revive Crystal.description: Revives a fainted monster with 50% HP.

Knowledge Tome.description: Study with a monster: 40 EXP, plus 20 EXP for every maths topic you have made Proficient.

EXP Star.description: A monster instantly gains enough EXP for its next level.

Evolution Crystal.description: Awakens the Evolution Shrine. Not used up.

Stone Charm.description: Bram's thanks. GEOMAX and GEOMAXIMUS take 10% less damage while you carry it.

Crystal Shard.description: A shard from the Crystal Seal. Sell it at the Mathmart.
